derivation: feminine from the same as H1728 (דַּוָּג);
def: properly, fishery, i.e. a hook forfishing

occurrences.text: The Lord God hath sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
